name: TextField
whenToUse: Short free text on one line: a name, an email, a domain, a URL, a code.
With a visible label above it, every time.

whenNotToUse.text: More than a line of text
A number people step up and down

anatomy.description: always visible; required fields get *, optional ones “(optional)” via `optional`.
with optional `leftIcon` / `rightIcon`; a clear button appears when filled.
help shown before typing: format, limits.
`error` or `success` text; replaces the description while shown.

do.caption: Label above; the placeholder only shows an example.

dont.caption: Placeholder as the label disappears as soon as people type.

do.caption: The error says what’s wrong and how to fix it.
do.example: <TextField label="Email" defaultValue="dana@seashell" error="Add the domain ending, like .com." widthSize="md" />

do.caption: Width hints at the expected length (`widthSize`).

dont.caption: A 6-digit code in a full-width field reads like “type a paragraph here”.

a11y: Pass `label` (or a `Label` with `htmlFor`); `aria-label` only where a visible label truly can’t exist.
Description and error are linked with `aria-describedby`; an error also sets `aria-invalid`.
Set `type`, `inputMode` and `autoComplete` — the right keyboard on phones and autofill everywhere.
Validate on leaving the field, re-check live once an error shows; never while someone types into an empty field.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text below the field. Hidden when `error` or `success` is set.

props.name: error
props.description:
Error message shown below the field with a warning icon, and
switches the field to its error styling. Pass `true` for error
styling with no message, or a string/node for styling + message.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: 'top' (default) stacks label above the field. 'left' puts a fixed 216px label column beside it, matching Figma's horizontal Formfield layout.

props.name: leftIcon
props.description: Icon shown at the start of the field (16px, decorative).

props.name: optional
props.description: Shows "(optional)" after the label. Ignored when `required`.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows a small red asterisk after the label.

props.name: rightIcon
props.description: Icon shown at the end of the field. Overrides the built-in clear button, error, and success icons when set.

props.name: success
props.description:
Success message shown below the field with a check icon, and
switches the field to its success styling. Pass `true` for success
styling with no message, or a string/node for styling + message.
Ignored when `error` is set.
